sections.A: COPD phephron ki lambi bimari hai jis mein hawa ka bahao lagataar kam rehta hai, aksar smoking ki wajah se. Yeh roki ja sakti hai aur pulmonary rehab se kaafi behtari aati hai.
sections.B: Mehnat par barhti saans ki takleef, purani khansi, balgham aur wheeze. Seena phoola hua aur gardan ki muscles se saans lena.
sections.C: Kitna chal kar saans ke liye rukna parta hai (mMRC), kitni baar bimari bigarti hai, smoking aur oxygen ka istemal.
sections.D: Aaraam mein vital signs aur SpO2, seene ki aawaz (auscultation), seene ka phailao aur pairon ki sujan.
sections.E: mMRC, CAT, 6MWT, quadriceps ki taaqat aur sit-to-stand se bimari ka asar aur salahiyat napte hain.
sections.F: Asthma (symptoms badalte rehte hain, kam umar) aur heart failure (lait kar saans phoolna, sujan) isi jaise lag sakte hain.
sections.G: Achanak shadeed saans ki takleef, bol na sakna, confusion ya neend: emergency.
sections.H: Stable hai ya bimari bigri hui? Hospital mein: breathing control, positioning aur airway clearance. Stable: pulmonary rehabilitation.
sections.I: Breathing control, pursed-lip breathing, aaraam ki positions aur zaroorat ho to airway clearance (ACBT).
sections.J: Pulmonary rehab: hafte mein 3-5 din walking ya cycling, taaqat ki exercise, aur saans ki takleef ka scale dekh kar dheere dheere barhana.
sections.K: Jin ka oxygen exercise mein girta hai unhein prescription ke mutabiq oxygen.
sections.L: Assessment aur goals, breathing techniques, pulmonary rehab, education, aur ghar par lambi activity.
sections.M: 6MWT ya ISWT, CAT, mMRC, quadriceps taaqat, sit-to-stand aur bimari bigarne ki frequency dobara dekhein.
sections.N: 66 saal ka purana smoker 6MWT mein 260 m chalta hai. Khud socho kya program banana hai, phir jawab dekho.
sections.chapter-summary-treatment-decision: Mukhtasar: education ke saath pulmonary rehabilitation.
sections.now-you-should-be-able-to: Yeh checklist hai. Har point khud kar sakein to tick karein.
